0.0: Ah! You learned the monster riding skill from me! You have a Pig... Wow! You really live with a monster! And it doesn't attack you? My research has been proven as viable! I'm as happy as a pig in mud!
0.1: You'll be happy to know that I learned how to strengthen monsters for riding a few days ago! The name tells you how strong it is: #b#t1902001##k. Haha. Isn't it cool? What do you say? Would you like to strengthen your monster?

yes.0: I knew it! Okay, to strengthen your monsters, I'll need #b500 #t4000261#s and 500 #t4000262#s. Upgraded monsters are faster and tougher, so you'll need many ingredients. When you have everything, come back and we'll continue! See you then!
yes.1: Ah, right. I'm sorry but it costs a lot for this type of research and I'm a bit short on funds. A donation of #b50 million mesos#k should do it. I can study further into the coexistence of humans and monsters. Thank you!

no.0: Huh? You don't want a stronger mount? I suppose you're happy with your Pig now, I won't press you any more. When you change your mind, let me know!

1.0: Wow. You have everything that I need. Excellent! It's easy to strengthen monsters with this. I'll even change the color of the mane to gray!
1.1: Ok. Your #t1902000# is changed to #b#t1902001##k. I did it! Try it out!

yes.0: Remember, when tired, #t1902001# can't run that well. Please be careful!

item.0: You need ALL the ingredients to ride the #t1902001#. The ingredients are... 500 #b#t4000261# items, 500 #t4000262# items, and 50,000,000 mesos#k.
